title: American Grilled Cheese Flatbread
description: A twist on the classic grilled cheese, using a crispy flatbread for a satisfying snack.
instructions: Preheat a grill or grill pan to medium heat.
Slice the flatbread into two portions.
Butter one side of each portion.
Place one slice, butter side down, on the grill.
Top with a slice of cheese.
Place the second slice of flatbread, butter side up, on top of the cheese.
Cook for 2-3 minutes or until the bread is golden brown and the cheese is melted.
Flip and cook for an additional 2 minutes.
Serve with additional crusty bread on the side for dipping in any remaining cheese.
